E.typed: RunFailureError.toFailure sets node from options/current node, default resumable true; details JSON-serialized. Ordinary INTERNAL_ERROR details stripped at failRun unless explicit InternalRunFailureError engine-owned projection.
E.precedence: ChildCancelledError first. Unconfirmed native termination marks cleanup veto. Forced stop precedes ordinary failure; run deadline precedes abort cancellation unless explicit cancellation requested; then abort/current controller cancels. On successful late handler return explicit cancel wins before run deadline. These are source branch order, not race acceptance evidence.

I.description: Guarded inference main try starts after prompt preparation; context-admission catch is distinct.
I.precedence: Cancel completed handle; fold cleanup safety evidence. Node timeout sets HARNESS_TIMEOUT; missing-session/termination/pinned evidence rank above ordinary. Cancellation replaces ordinary failure unless unconfirmed termination or node timeout. Executor E then applies run-level precedence.
I.recovery: Recorded exact turn identity/prompt retained. Accepted work cannot become definitely-not-submitted. Uncertain work resumes only usable session; inherited authored handle requires durable acceptance or new usable session. Fresh replay is separate. Non-resumable typed authored choice must not be inferred to authorize repeated external work.

S.description: Script visit/dispatched provenance is reclassified before failure persistence.
S.policy: Unfinished prior visit/dispatch prevents automatic script invocation. Generic post-dispatch bookkeeping escape becomes SCRIPT_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN with script visit/dispatch/state; interruption/deadline retain their authoritative non-resumable code plus uncertainty evidence. Ordinary API Resume requires explicit script consent via recovery policy.

N.policy: Child failure code,resumable,script copied; parent node becomes subloop node; details wrap childRunId, optional childNodeId, childDetails; child message prefixed. Inference field not copied by this wrapper. Child INTERNAL_ERROR projects engine-owned safe historical diagnostic slots before new parent persistence; stored child rows unchanged. Child cancellation cancels ancestors. Authored Failure exit is ordinary data. Explicit parent resume can resume same resumable failed child in place; crash retry alone does not select child resume. Mapping retry reuses completed child and retains/deduplicates completion records.

public_projections.facts: RunFailure strict object: enum code, message <=10000 JS characters, optional slug node/details JSON/script/inference/missingSession, required resumable. details uses z.json with no additional per-cause/size cap here. boundedAuthoredCause caps at1000 incl ellipsis; expression runtime/nested-$eval message helper independently truncates1000 then adds suffix/prefix, not a guaranteed1000 total; compile/unsafe-regex errors preserve expression details. TemplateError may carry first200 template chars in domain details but whole message not bounded locally. boundedFailure truncates ONLY failure.message with original-length marker; invalid metadata falls back EVENT_INVALID non-resumable, no node/details.

Script evidence classification first. Ordinary INTERNAL_ERROR gets fixed public message and details removed unless explicit engine-owned InternalRunFailureError; toFailure details JSON serialize (fallback String on failure). Bounded payload appended as run.failed before failed row transition. Child historical projection only redacts known engine diagnostic slots when publishing new parent failure; no rewrite of stored old failure/event. Failure row is JSON; event payload contains same validated RunFailure. Append validates complete event inside transaction before insert; listener errors cannot roll back committed event.
